VALIDATION REPORT
=================

Validated on 2026-07-13 with GCC and Clang.

PASS: strict ISO C89 compilation
  -std=c89 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic-errors

PASS: Total Solver self-test
  - caller arena begins unaligned
  - every internal arena segment aligned
  - legacy preStep/postStep callbacks chained and restored
  - contacts appended before the step preserved
  - collision provider contacts generated automatically
  - external transform provider read/write
  - external parent mapping
  - external compose callback invoked
  - missing math operations use fixed-point fallback
  - physics authority writes body pose to scene transform
  - post-physics follow/socket constraint
  - CCD without sweep provider keeps uniform substepping

PASS: pair-cache churn
  - 2200 historical pairs with a 2048-entry pair cache
  - replacement remains valid and emits END for an evicted active pair

PASS: feature builds
  - VP_ENABLE_ISLANDS=0
  - VP_ENABLE_SPLIT_IMPULSE=0
  - both disabled together
  - VP_ENABLE_MANIFOLDS=0 build compatibility

PASS: AddressSanitizer + UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer self-test
PASS: Clang strict C89 self-test
PASS: GCC strict C89 self-test

Strict directories checked:
  include/
  src/
  examples/
  tests/

No heap allocation calls and no floating-point types are used by the strict
core. The optional compat/vp_fixed_float_compat.h migration shim is isolated
and never included by the strict build.
